Shreya Rao
Senior Azure DevOps Engineer | Thane West
shreya.rao759@example.com | +91 9853850140

Senior Azure DevOps Engineer with hands-on experience designing and automating cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines. Strong focus on Terraform-driven infrastructure as code and Azure platform services to improve deployment frequency, reduce lead time for changes, and increase system reliability. Open to relocating to Pune or Bengaluru. Immediate joiner.

Experience
Wipro — Jul 2024 - Present
Senior Azure DevOps Engineer | Remote/Onsite
- Designed and implemented Terraform modules to provision networking, AKS clusters, and Key Vaults in Microsoft Azure, reducing manual setup time by 65% and cutting environment provisioning from 6 hours to 2 hours.
- Built and maintained Azure DevOps pipelines for multi-tenant applications, achieving 40% faster deployments and enabling automated rollback on failed releases.
- Implemented infrastructure drift detection and automated remediation scripts on Linux build agents, decreasing configuration-related incidents by 35%.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints using Jira to prioritize platform improvements and delivered three high-impact platform projects within two quarters.

Ledgerly — Jun 2020 - Jun 2024
Cloud Engineer | Remote/Hybrid
- Led migration of core services to Microsoft Azure using Infrastructure as Code; authored Terraform configurations that provisioned VMs, managed identities, and storage accounts, cutting cloud spend by 18% through right-sizing and automation.
- Created and optimized Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for microservices, reducing build times by 30% and increasing release cadence from biweekly to weekly.
- Managed Linux-based build and deployment infrastructure, implementing monitoring and automated patching that reduced mean time to recovery by 25%.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies and tracked work in Jira, improving sprint predictability and delivering three major feature releases on schedule.
